Subject: Discovery recap & next step: tri-region timeband pilot for technical deep dive

Hi Jin / Claire —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: technical deep dive (team-to-team) to validate throughput, PKI/SSO integration, and prefix-caching behavior against two representative workloads.
- Key attendees you asked for: Eng lead (APAC), Security/Compliance, and 1 product owner.
- Proposed format: 60–75 minute deep dive (45m demo + 15–30m Q/A + optional breakout with infra).

Scheduling ask (tri-region constraints): your APAC engineers prefer local mornings; EU prefers late mornings/early afternoons CET; US prefers US mornings PST. To avoid excluding any team and to minimize late-night calls, we propose a short pilot of rotating "timebands" so each week one region gets a convenient local slot for the live deep-dive while others join at reasonable offsets. 

Pilot proposal (three-week rotating schedule):
- Week 1 (APAC-friendly): 08:00 SGT / 01:00 CET / previous-day 19:00 PST
- Week 2 (EU-friendly): 10:30 CET / 01:30 SGT / 04:30 PST
- Week 3 (US-friendly): 09:00 PST / 17:00 CET / 00:00 SGT

We can offer two parallel recurring slots per week (primary + replay/office-hours) if that helps reduce missed participants. Suggested duration for each live slot: 75 minutes.

Attached is a draft mutual action plan (Atlas_MAPlan_v1) with objectives and required artifacts for the deep dive. Please flag any blockers and tell us which week type (APAC/EU/US) you prefer to kick off the pilot. Once we agree, we'll send a rotating calendar invite (ICS) that encodes the weekly rotation.

Next steps requested from Atlas:
1) Confirm preferred kickoff week (APAC/EU/US)
2) Share list of attendees (names + timezones + Slack handle)
3) Confirm whether SOC2 evidence exchange should happen before or after the deep dive (Ben added for that context).

Thanks — happy to adapt the cadence if you have a different preference.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
